requirements: Teachers can mark student attendance via biometric fingerprint scan at the start of each class to ensure real-time and tamper-proof recording.
The system must automatically generate a daily attendance report for each class, including the number of present, absent, and late students, and send it to the class teacher via email by 4 PM.
Parents receive an instant push notification (via the school’s mobile app) when their child is marked absent without prior notice, including the reason for absence if provided by the teacher.
Students can view their own attendance history for the current academic year through the student portal, including daily attendance status and percentage of attendance.

The system must allow the school administrator to configure attendance policies, such as the minimum required attendance percentage for exams eligibility (e.g., 75%), and enforce these rules during grade calculation.

Teachers can submit a request to the administrator to manually override a student’s attendance record in case of a valid reason (e.g., medical leave), which must be approved before the change is reflected in reports.
The system must integrate with the school’s timetable module to auto-populate attendance records based on scheduled classes, reducing manual entry errors.
Parents can submit a leave application through the parent portal, which is routed to the class teacher for approval; approved leaves are automatically reflected in the attendance records.
The system must flag students with attendance below the required threshold (e.g., 75%) and notify the class teacher and school counselor via dashboard alerts for follow-up actions.
Teachers can take a photo of the class during attendance marking to visually verify the presence of students, which is stored securely and linked to the attendance record for audit purposes.
The system must process and store attendance data with a latency of less than 2 seconds to ensure real-time updates during class sessions.
Attendance records must be retained for a minimum of 5 academic years and be accessible within 10 seconds for retrieval requests from authorized users.
The system must comply with GDPR and local education data protection laws, ensuring that student attendance data is encrypted at rest and in transit.
The mobile app for parents and students must support offline mode, syncing attendance data once connectivity is restored without data loss.
The system must handle a peak load of 500 concurrent users (teachers, students, parents) during attendance marking periods without performance degradation.

risk_report.stage: Gather detailed requirements and create functional specifications
risk_report.risk: Incomplete or ambiguous requirements may lead to scope creep or misaligned system features.
risk_report.mitigation: Conduct structured workshops with stakeholders to validate and sign-off on detailed functional specifications before proceeding.

risk_report.stage: Design system architecture and high-level components
risk_report.risk: Overly complex architecture may hinder scalability or integration with existing school systems.
risk_report.mitigation: Adopt a modular microservices approach with clear boundaries to simplify future integrations and scalability.

risk_report.stage: Design database schema for attendance records and related entities
risk_report.risk: Poor schema design may result in performance bottlenecks or data integrity issues during high-volume attendance processing.
risk_report.mitigation: Normalize critical tables but denormalize for read-heavy operations; conduct schema reviews with database experts.

risk_report.stage: Design API endpoints for attendance marking, reporting, and notifications
risk_report.risk: Inadequate API design may lead to security vulnerabilities or inefficient data transfer between components.
risk_report.mitigation: Follow RESTful principles with strict input validation and rate limiting; conduct threat modeling for API security.

risk_report.stage: Design user interfaces for teacher, student, parent, and admin portals
risk_report.risk: Poor UX design may result in low adoption rates among non-technical users like parents and teachers.
risk_report.mitigation: Prototype UI mockups and conduct usability testing with representative end-users before finalizing designs.

risk_report.stage: Design mobile app architecture and offline sync strategy
risk_report.risk: Offline sync conflicts or data loss may occur due to poor conflict resolution or synchronization logic.
risk_report.mitigation: Implement conflict-free replicated data types (CRDTs) or operational transformation for offline sync with conflict resolution rules.

risk_report.stage: Implement biometric fingerprint integration module
risk_report.risk: Biometric data handling may violate privacy laws or fail to meet GDPR compliance requirements.
risk_report.mitigation: Ensure biometric data is stored locally on devices with user consent and never transmitted or stored centrally.

risk_report.stage: Implement backend services for attendance recording and processing
risk_report.risk: Race conditions or data corruption may occur during high-concurrency attendance marking events.
risk_report.mitigation: Use distributed locks or transactional outbox patterns to ensure atomic operations during concurrent updates.

risk_report.stage: Implement real-time attendance update and notification engine
risk_report.risk: Notification delays or failures may result in missed alerts for critical attendance events.
risk_report.mitigation: Implement a resilient message queue with retry policies and dead-letter queues for failed notifications.

risk_report.stage: Implement daily attendance report generation and email dispatch
risk_report.risk: Report generation may time out or fail under high load during end-of-day processing.
risk_report.mitigation: Schedule report generation during off-peak hours and use batch processing with pagination for large datasets.

risk_report.stage: Implement parent push notification system via school mobile app
risk_report.risk: Push notification delivery may be unreliable due to platform-specific constraints or user opt-outs.
risk_report.mitigation: Implement fallback channels (email/SMS) and monitor push service health with automated alerts.

risk_report.stage: Implement student attendance history and percentage calculation
risk_report.risk: Incorrect calculation logic may lead to inaccurate attendance percentages and compliance violations.
risk_report.mitigation: Validate calculation logic against regulatory requirements and conduct peer reviews with domain experts.

risk_report.stage: Implement attendance policy configuration and enforcement module
risk_report.risk: Policy misconfiguration may lead to incorrect enforcement or legal disputes with parents.
risk_report.mitigation: Implement a policy simulation tool to validate enforcement logic before deployment.

risk_report.stage: Implement attendance override request and approval workflow
risk_report.risk: Manual approval processes may cause delays or inconsistent handling of override requests.
risk_report.mitigation: Automate approval workflows based on configurable rules while allowing manual override for exceptional cases.

risk_report.stage: Integrate with school timetable module for auto-population
risk_report.risk: Timetable data inconsistencies may lead to incorrect attendance marking or reporting.
risk_report.mitigation: Implement data validation and reconciliation processes between attendance and timetable systems.

risk_report.stage: Implement parent leave application and approval workflow
risk_report.risk: Leave requests may be mishandled due to poor workflow design or lack of notifications.
risk_report.mitigation: Implement a transparent approval workflow with status tracking and automated notifications.

risk_report.stage: Implement attendance threshold monitoring and dashboard alerts
risk_report.risk: False alerts or missed critical thresholds may erode trust in the monitoring system.
risk_report.mitigation: Calibrate alert thresholds using historical data and implement multi-level escalation policies.

risk_report.stage: Implement photo capture and secure storage for attendance verification
risk_report.risk: Unauthorized access to stored photos may violate student privacy or GDPR requirements.
risk_report.mitigation: Encrypt photos at rest with access controls and implement strict retention policies with automatic deletion.

risk_report.stage: Develop mobile app frontend for parents and students with offline support
risk_report.risk: Offline data corruption or sync errors may lead to inconsistent attendance records.
risk_report.mitigation: Implement robust data validation and conflict resolution during sync with server-side conflict logging.

risk_report.stage: Develop web portal frontend for teachers, students, and administrators
risk_report.risk: Cross-site scripting (XSS) or injection attacks may compromise user data in web portals.
risk_report.mitigation: Conduct security code reviews and implement CSP headers, input sanitization, and output encoding.

risk_report.stage: Implement data encryption at rest and in transit (GDPR compliance)
risk_report.risk: Improper key management or encryption implementation may lead to data breaches or compliance failures.
risk_report.mitigation: Use industry-standard encryption libraries (e.g., AES-256) and manage keys with a dedicated HSM or cloud KMS.

risk_report.stage: Implement performance optimization for real-time processing (<2s latency)
risk_report.risk: Performance bottlenecks may cause unacceptable delays during peak usage times.
risk_report.mitigation: Conduct load testing with realistic scenarios and optimize database queries, caching, and API responses.

risk_report.stage: Implement data retention and retrieval system (5 years, <10s access)
risk_report.risk: Archived data may become inaccessible or corrupted over time, violating retention policies.
risk_report.mitigation: Use tiered storage (hot/warm/cold) with automated lifecycle policies and regular data integrity checks.

risk_report.stage: Conduct unit testing for all modules and integrations
risk_report.risk: Insufficient test coverage may allow bugs to reach production, especially in complex workflows.
risk_report.mitigation: Implement TDD practices and require >90% code coverage with integration test suites for critical paths.

risk_report.stage: Perform integration testing across all system components
risk_report.risk: Integration failures may go undetected until production, causing system-wide outages.
risk_report.mitigation: Use contract testing and service virtualization to simulate dependencies during integration testing.

risk_report.stage: Conduct load testing for 500 concurrent users
risk_report.risk: System may fail under load due to unoptimized queries, memory leaks, or insufficient infrastructure.
risk_report.mitigation: Scale infrastructure horizontally and use profiling tools to identify and resolve bottlenecks.

risk_report.stage: Execute user acceptance testing (UAT) with stakeholders
risk_report.risk: Stakeholders may reject the system due to misaligned expectations or usability issues.
risk_report.mitigation: Involve end-users early in the design process and conduct iterative UAT with clear acceptance criteria.

risk_report.stage: Prepare production environment and infrastructure
risk_report.risk: Configuration drift or missing dependencies may cause deployment failures or security vulnerabilities.
risk_report.mitigation: Use infrastructure-as-code (IaC) and immutable infrastructure patterns with automated compliance checks.

risk_report.stage: Deploy backend services and databases to production
risk_report.risk: Data loss or corruption may occur during deployment due to improper backup or rollback procedures.
risk_report.mitigation: Implement blue-green deployments with automated backups and rollback capabilities.

risk_report.stage: Deploy web portals and admin interfaces to production
risk_report.risk: Frontend deployment issues may cause downtime or broken user experiences.
risk_report.mitigation: Use CDN caching and feature flags to enable gradual rollouts and quick rollbacks.

risk_report.stage: Publish mobile apps to app stores and configure push notifications
risk_report.risk: App store rejection or push notification service failures may delay go-live.
risk_report.mitigation: Follow app store guidelines closely and test push notification services with sandbox environments.

risk_report.stage: Conduct final system validation and go-live approval
risk_report.risk: Critical issues may be discovered too late, leading to reputational damage or legal consequences.
risk_report.mitigation: Implement a phased go-live approach with a pilot group and strict rollback criteria.

risk_report.stage: Provide user training and documentation
risk_report.risk: Inadequate training may lead to low user adoption or misuse of system features.
risk_report.mitigation: Develop role-specific training materials and conduct hands-on workshops with follow-up support.

risk_report.stage: Monitor system performance and address post-deployment issues
risk_report.risk: Undetected performance degradation or security incidents may escalate into major incidents.
risk_report.mitigation: Implement real-time monitoring with automated alerts and a dedicated incident response team.
